connectionHelp: Your daemon runs the experiments. This browser connects only to its current origin. An expiring session token stays in this tab unless you choose to keep it on this browser; your master credential is never saved.
updateAvailable: A newer WaveDL build is available
credentialHelp: Paste the credential provided by WaveDL. It is exchanged for an expiring session token and never saved.
keepMeSignedInOnThisBrowser: Keep me signed in on this browser
sessionStorageHelp: Saves only the expiring session token in this browser. Your master credential is never saved.
disconnectHelp: Disconnecting never cancels running jobs. An offline page cannot confirm live status or perform actions. A changed daemon identity requires an explicit disconnect before starting a new scope.
languageHelp: Choose the language used throughout this workstation.
appearanceSessionOnly: Applied for this session. Browser storage is unavailable.
appearanceHelp: Changes apply immediately in this browser. They do not restart or reconfigure the daemon.
downloadsHelp: Your browser chooses where exported files and downloaded artifacts are saved. Use its download settings to change the default folder or ask where to save each file. The workstation cannot set a local filesystem folder.
aboutDescription: Wave-based deep-learning experiments, planned and executed by your daemon.
feedbackPrivacyHelp: Do not include access tokens, private paths or training data in public feedback. Reloads are always user initiated.
trainingDefaultsHelp: Saved separately for each verified daemon identity, in this browser only. Dataset, model, runtime, credentials and executable-code selections are never saved here. Existing drafts, approved plans and submitted runs are unchanged.
trainingDefaultsDisconnected: Connect to a daemon to configure its training defaults.
loggingHelp: W&B remains optional. Its credentials and project selection belong to the daemon host or the explicit run draft. No previous run cache is deleted.
trainingDefaultsSaved: Defaults saved for new drafts on this daemon.
trainingDefaultsSaveFailed: Defaults could not be saved. Browser storage may be unavailable or full.
trainingDefaultsReset: Training defaults reset. Existing drafts and runs are unchanged.
